title: Lead Capture
summary: Every lead = instant record + reply + alert — nothing lost

sections.heading: Orientation — Lesson Start
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
- What will you understand? Lead capture automation prevents losing potential customers — recording replies and alerts.
- Why now? A bridge between external interest and your operational system.

sections.heading: Tension — 'They were interested — then they disappeared'
sections.subtitle: 'They were interested — then they disappeared'
sections.contentMarkdown:

- No system captures every Lead immediately.

sections.heading: Core idea — Every lead = record + reply + alert
sections.subtitle: Every lead = record + reply + alert
sections.contentMarkdown:
- At the moment of recording → save → welcome reply → follow-up alert.
- Webhook for instant notification when the form is submitted.
